skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK damage to a single target and enters the [Berserk] state for 1 turn (DMG dealt increased by 30%).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Each Esper-type ally raises Boros' ATK, increasing skill strength by 105%, up to 3 stacks (+50% ATK per stack). Strikes a single target with a 3-hit combo, dealing 70% ATK damage per hit.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Each Esper-type ally raises Boros' ATK, increasing skill strength by 158%, up to 3 stacks (+60% ATK per stack). Strikes a single target with a 3-hit combo, dealing 88% ATK damage per hit.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP. When allies restore HP, Boros is healed for 60% of that value, triggering up to 6 times per turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP. When allies restore HP, Boros is healed for 80% of that value, triggering up to 8 times per turn.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP. When allies restore HP, Boros is healed for 85% of that value, triggering up to 8 times per turn.
